faqs.q: Do I have to use the shop my insurance recommends?
faqs.a: No. In Michigan you choose the repair shop. We work directly with every insurer and handle the paperwork either way.

faqs.q: How long will the repair take?
faqs.a: Small bumper jobs are often 2 to 3 days. Bigger structural work depends on parts. You'll get a realistic timeline with the estimate and updates along the way.
Yes. We computer-match the color and blend into neighboring panels so there's no visible line. Paint is warrantied for as long as you own the car.

faqs.q: Can you help with a rental?
faqs.a: Yes. We coordinate with your insurer's rental coverage and can have a car waiting when you drop off.
